At OpenMined, Kelly E Trask has contributed to a global community building tools for privacy-preserving data collaboration. She has written for the foundation about meaningful privacy and was named among the contributors to a United Nations guide on privacy-enhancing technologies.

Trask studied business administration and marketing at Oklahoma State University. Her volunteer work later included directing multi-state speech-and-debate tournaments, recruiting hundreds of judges and coaching students in current-affairs speaking. At OpenMined she worked on prospecting and recruitment for a medical federated-learning programme, helping coordinate participation around the responsible use of sensitive data.
